_about: 4-04, weightless, and two shock agents seal the way: a ring kills by a point test on his centre (a 28 u
ring at (104, 112) fills the one gap, x 80-130, between the upper corridor he starts in and the lower one
that holds the door; a 48 u ring at (226, 160) fills the lower corridor, x 178-274); only a fireball removes
one and the level has none, and a shot's ray ignores a ring. So it is two portal pairs, every move a recoil
(140 u/s away from where the ray ended, added, nothing slows him) and every rest a wall.
1. Tick 29, a tap at the right block, (300, 64): a doomed shot at its face (256, 64) (red_cross, no portal)
whose recoil sends him left along y 64 through the crystals at 192, 160, 128 (ticks 41, 55, 69) to rest on
the wall at x 90.7 (tick 94). 2. Tick 100, (110, 162): down the gap past the ring, portal A opens at
(110, 164) on 125; the recoil lifts him to the ceiling, (89.3, 50.3), on 107. 3. Tick 132 (after A landed),
(96, 64), a tap 14 u under him: its recoil, (-61, -126), is up and into both walls, portal B opens on 134
and he goes through to A with no velocity (the portal sets him at the partner's own point and turns his y
velocity) and hangs at (110, 164), 6 u above the floor and 52 from the ring's centre, and takes the crystal
at 96. 4. Tick 162, (300, 163.7), level with him: portal A' opens at (300, 165.7) on 215 (a 52-tick flight,
26 u right of the second ring's edge), replacing A, and the recoil carries him left along y 164 to the wall
at x 42.3 (tick 192), by the crystal at 48 (tick 180). 5. Tick 226 (after A' landed), (36, 164.1), a tap
level with him on the wall side: B' replaces B on 228, the recoil sends him right at 140 u/s into B' and out
of A' still flying right at 140, to the door on tick 238 (23 u in 10 ticks).
Every step keeps him off the floor on purpose. In the tries that led here a third tap that left him a
downward velocity at the portal dropped him to the floor ((104, 58) with the first shot at (91, 162): v (0, 54)
at A), and the slide along it from x 91 to the wall crosses the seam of platform_ent_2128 and block00_ent_2170
at x 64, which bumped him sideways, v (-100, -63), in one try and not in another; a tap above his height
sent him up through the gap into the ring ((97, 50): dead on tick 181). A route should stand on neither, so
the third tap is aimed on the plateau where he arrives at rest. Leans on the decoded zero-g recoil (G10), the
shot's flight (G4), the ray's ignore and the portal's exit; the walls stopping him dead is the solver's, as in 4-06; nothing is a
creep, a push or a one-tick margin. Margins, each measured by moving one tap and leaving the rest: tap ticks
the first 4 earlier (the 400 ms from the level's start) to 9 later, the second 9 earlier to 6 later, the
third 6 earlier (A lands on 125) to 4 later (5 later meets the 400 ms of the fourth), the fourth 4 earlier
(the 400 ms) to 9 later, the fifth 9 earlier (A' lands on 215) to 9 later; aims: the shot down the gap x
96-150, y 156-166; the third tap x 84-108, y 52-80 (5 u left to 19 u right of him, 2 u to 30 u under him; y 48 and
above is not won); the shot to the far end x 274-322, y 150-178; the last tap x 32-42, y 153-174. Unlocks no
achievement (none belongs to 4-04); all five crystals taken, medal 3 (4 portals).
